title: First spoken-pocket interpretation
intent: Describe the bodily call-and-response the drummer should hear before reading the grid.

player_brief.meter_and_tempo: 4/4 around 120 BPM, if the observed attacks are heard as quarter-note landmarks.
player_brief.subdivision_and_feel: Straight eighth-note body with sixteenth-note space available; keep the openings open.
player_brief.backbeat_or_answer: Let the brighter spoken gesture answer on 2 and 4.
player_brief.bass_drum_or_low_voice: Let the rounder boom gesture ground 1 and 3.
player_brief.timekeeping_voice: Begin without a continuous timekeeping voice so the core exchange stays exposed.
player_brief.dynamics: Describe the relative weight, accents, ghosts, and phrase-level rise or release.
player_brief.orchestration: Describe the drummer-facing voices and why each belongs.
player_brief.phrase_shape: One-bar low call, bright answer, low call, bright answer, then breathe.
player_brief.pocket: Stay close to the performed spacing; do not manufacture feel with random timing.
player_brief.listening_question: Does this audition preserve what the spoken phrase asks a drummer to do?
preserve: the alternating low and bright gestures
avoid: claiming the grid is a transcription
adding subdivisions before the call-and-response works

voices.player_instruction: Play the boom as a short grounded call on 1 and 3.
Answer compactly on 2 and 4 and leave the surrounding air empty.

event_interpretations.interpretation: Hear the first low gesture as the phrase downbeat.
event_interpretations.timing_intent: Anchor the proposed grid here without moving the source performance.

event_interpretations.interpretation: Hear the bright gesture as the answer on beat 2.
event_interpretations.timing_intent: Preserve its measured relationship to the first boom as evidence.

event_interpretations.interpretation: Repeat the grounded call on beat 3.
event_interpretations.timing_intent: Do not use humanize to imitate the original timing.

event_interpretations.interpretation: Close the bar with the second bright answer.

alternatives.name: Half-time landmarks
alternatives.description: Hear each low-high pair across a slower two-beat span before choosing the pulse.

alternatives.name: Free call and response
alternatives.description: Keep the attacks unmetered and let a drummer answer only after the phrase.
